'''2005 Michigan Mini-Open James Booker DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2005 Michigan Mini-Open]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by James "darthbooker" Booker (2005-03-30).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34637 DS Deck I'm Taking To Maryland]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050503114902/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34637&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
